name: Rishabh Pant Looking For The Ball
visual_description: Indian wicketkeeper Rishabh Pant looks up at the sky in confusion searching for the cricket ball, while it is right between his legs.
usage_context: Used to mock situations where someone is desperately searching for something that is right in front of them or completely obvious.

example.top_text: Me looking for my phone using my phone's flashlight

text_areas.description: Caption describing searching for something that is right in front of you
